activeSlice.scope: Add shadow-only Feedback V2 Preference State projection: ordered idempotent event reduction, passive-event neutrality, gradual positive/negative learning, mechanism/source-class specificity, bounded exploration-budget adaptation and diagnostics. Existing production feedback mutation remains authoritative.
successCriteria: Feedback V2 events are deterministically ordered and deduplicated by idempotency key before learning.
Impression, opened and performance_observed remain preference-neutral.
Explicit positive/negative feedback updates only relevant topic/audience/format/channel/mechanism/source dimensions with bounded weights.
Exploration feedback adjusts exploration budget only within the EEI policy band and cannot collapse to zero.
Repeated feedback decays over time and diagnostics expose applied, duplicate, passive and dimension-update counts.
No production feedback store wiring, provider credentials, scheduling, UI changes or deployment are introduced.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before certification.
